name: app-concentric-circle-user-persona-slide
title: Concentric Circle Persona Slide
whatItIs: A white slide with a mixed sans and italic serif headline, a persona portrait sitting on two large concentric hairline circles containing a quote and Goals text, with Pain and Gain blocks at the sides and an icon tab bar below.
whatItMeans: Circles place the person at the centre, and pain and gain flank them like a balance.
techniques: Persona portrait cut out over a circle edge
Pain and Gain placed left and right
Square nodes on the circle line
Mini avatar switcher and pill tab bar

vocabulary.definition: Circles sharing a centre used to nest information.
Paired blocks describing frustrations and benefits.
A person masked from the background.
